'''Mount Sarrano''' was a dormant [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. The [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Serres Sarrano]] was built on the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
